patch: m5rest: local registry patch for t-2026-11-13-mettadinc-m5-rest (beyond-release only; the order says names the specification does not register go beyond the registry). Adds the Machine read annotation (Read action Shared|Fresh), the MayTraceWitness witness type, and notes for the formula node and certificate kind names the nondeterministic handlers emit.

Read.doc: nondeterministic profile: (Read action Shared|Fresh) declares whether repeated reads of the choice made by action return the same value (Shared) or an independent one (Fresh); declared, never inferred (guide invariant 14); part of the interface identity

notes.m5rest-formula-nodes: ModalTestWitness Formula nodes for Profile Nondeterministic: (Indicator o v), (Not k), (And k..) and (Min k..) (empty = 1), (Sub k r) = max(0, phi_k - r), (Diamond a k [g]) = g times the max over a-successors (0 when none).
notes.m5rest-certificate-kinds: Certificate kinds emitted by Profile Nondeterministic beyond the registered Test/Prefixpoint/LayeredPrefixpoint: PartitionRefinement (BehavioralTolerance), Bisimulation (CheckBehavioral, crisp), MayTraceSubsetPairs (CheckTrace, closed subset-pair table).
